title: Structure-Guided Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer for Efficient Monocular 3D Human Pose Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.20361v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing multi-granularity methods for monocular 3D human pose estimation emphasize spatial joint features while underusing skeletal structure, including global connectivity and temporal continuity. Moreover, modeling entire frame sequences incurs high computational costs. We propose a Structure-Aware Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer that integrates structural priors across spatial and temporal representations for accurate and efficient pose estimation. A three-level feature extractor captures human topology at the joint, bone, and limb levels. Gated Adaptive Spatial Attention (GASA) embeds structural constraints into spatial attention, while Multi-Granularity Feature Enhancement (MGFE) uses hierarchical pooling and fusion to strengthen local details and global semantics. translated_title: 结构引导的多粒度时空Transformer用于高效的单目3D人体姿态估计
translated_abstract: 现有的单目3D人体姿态估计多粒度方法强调空间关节特征，而未能充分利用骨骼结构，包括全局连接性和时间连续性。此外，对完整帧序列建模会带来高昂的计算成本。我们提出了一种结构感知的多粒度时空Transformer，它将结构先验融入空间和时间表示中，以实现准确且高效的姿态估计。三级特征提取器在关节、骨骼和肢体三个层面捕获人体拓扑结构。门控自适应空间注意力（GASA）将结构约束嵌入空间注意力中，而多粒度特征增强（MGFE）使用分层池化和融合来强化局部细节和全局语义。时间分段融合（TSF）对齐跨粒度的时间上下文，以捕获短程和长程运动模式。层次化交叉注……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种结构感知的多粒度时空Transformer，将骨骼结构先验融入关节、骨骼、肢体三个粒度的空间与时间建模中，在显著降低计算成本的同时实现更准确的单目3D人体姿态估计。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Structure-Aware Multi-Granularity Spatiotemporal Transformer that integrates skeletal structural priors into spatial and temporal modeling across joint, bone, and limb granularities, achieving more accurate and computationally efficient monocular 3D human pose estimation.
